error.what: s9's check refuses every internal/job change
error.why: the owner accepted five lint-only _test.go files at the perimeter step, so the check fails although the scenario's then holds

amendment.given: A branch whose only internal/job changes are lint fixes in _test.go files
amendment.then: No non-test file under internal/job changed
amendment.check: ! git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD -- internal/job | grep -v '_test[.]go$' | grep -q .
amendment.reason: the check bans test files the then does not mention
